seo.title: Find the Letter! 🍎🍌 ABC for Kids | Letters A to D | Phonics Game | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Which one starts with A? 🤔 Play the ABC game with Kiddo! See the letter, pick the picture, and say it together!

A quick alphabet and phonics game for toddlers and preschool kids. In Part 1 we learn letters A to D:
🍎 A is for Apple
🍌 B is for Banana
🐈 C is for Cat
🦆 D is for Duck

Each round has think time so kids can choose, and a "say it with me" pause to practise letters and words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for the next letters, E to H!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
